`vp run embed && vp run generate` in `renderers/pendo` before `vp test` — the tests read

## Generic icon painter hijacks any class containing "-icon-"

`@pantoken/components`'s icon utility ships a global painter `[class*="-icon-"]::before { mask:
var(--pantoken-glyph) ... }`. Any element whose class list contains the literal substring `-icon-`
(e.g. `.platform-icon-viewport`, `.foo-icon-bar`) gets this `::before` painted on it too — even if
you never intended it to be an icon. Since `--pantoken-glyph` is usually unset/inherited on that
element, it renders as a solid/broken square overlapping your real content. Symptom: a mysteriously
solid-colored square where a mask-based glyph should be, with all inline styles/computed mask values
looking correct. Fix: never name a custom class with `-icon-` as a substring unless it's meant to be
a real glyph (e.g. use `.platform-glyph` instead of `.platform-icon`)."}
